title: Honey Gloss Hair Therapy Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Ceramide✓ All Hair Types✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Increases Shine
What it is: A Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy hair session featuring Gisou’s mini Shampoo, mini Conditioner, mini Hair Oil, and full-size Hair Mask.

Hair Texture: Straight, Wavy, Curly, and Coily

Hair Type: Fine, Medium, and Thick

Hair Concerns:
- Shine
- Frizz
- Dryness

Key Benefits:
- Boosts shine
- Long-lasting hydration

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Mirsalehi Honey: Hydrates and boosts shine.
- Biomimetic Ceramides: Targets damage and strengthens hair.

Ingredient Callouts: These products are vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This routine restores your best, healthiest-looking hair instantly and over time. Intensely
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
Cleanse with Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy Hydrating Shampoo:
-Emulsify to create a luxurious lather.
-Massage into wet scalp and hair, then rinse.

Nourish with The Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy Hair Mask:
-After shampooing, squeeze out excess water and evenly apply a generous amount of the hair mask over the lengths and ends of your hair.
-Wait for five to seven minutes.
-Rinse thoroughly.
-It’s lightweight enough to use at every wash.

Polish with the Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy Hydrating Conditioner:
-Squeeze out excess water and distribute evenly from mid-length to ends.
-Leave for one to two minutes, then rinse.

Shine with the Honey Infused Hair Oil:
-Apply a few drops into your palms and rub your hands together.
-Distribute evenly from mid-lengths to ends to lock-in moisture, tame flyaways, and add glossy shine.

-Mirsalehi Honey: Hydrates and boosts shine.
-Biomimetic Ceramides: Targets damage and strengthens hair.
